mainlineReference.purpose: Kletia's reviewed mainline API and source-layout reference; it is not the working developer-preview verifier implementation.

limitations: The linked deployment is an upstream developer demo for native XLM, not a Kletia USDC confidential treasury.
The demo's intentionally published auditor material must never be reused by Kletia.
Reference contract IDs can become stale after a Stellar Testnet reset and are not Kletia protocol pins.

blockers: Pin, vendor or reproducibly fetch the exact holder SDK and browser proving artifacts without exposing witness material.
Produce reproducible Kletia-specific verifier, auditor and Circle Testnet USDC wrapper WASM artifacts with source, circuit and verification-key hashes.
Generate Kletia-specific auditor keys and document immutable or explicitly governed administration; never reuse demo secrets.
Implement canonical event archival, gap detection, encrypted holder recovery and clean-device commitment reconstruction.
Pass invalid-proof, replay, stale-state, recipient separation, recovery and private-field-egress tests plus a real user-signed Stellar Testnet lifecycle.
kletiaIntegration.reason: An official working Testnet reference now exists, so the blocker is no longer upstream availability. Kletia remains fail-closed because its exact proof SDK, deployment identities, auditor policy, recovery path and end-to-end evidence are not integrated or validated.
